products.name: Youkai808
products.tagline: Experimental 808 destroyer: light bitcrush to blown-out, whining, comedic subs.
products.about: An experimental 808 destroyer and synth in one plugin. Start from a clean sub and drag it anywhere - a touch of grit, whining overtones, folding, full comedic blowout - then shape it with a stackable effects rack and generate the bassline right inside the plugin.
features: DRIVE - push the 808 harder into the whole chain
CHAOS - drives every effect further + sets how wild RANDOMIZE gets
FAT - thick saturated low-mids, denser sustain, wider top
MIX - blend from clean 808 to fully destroyed
BASS GUARD - kills low-end buildup, then brings the clean sub back
OUTPUT - final level with a built-in limiter so it never clips
CURSED - drag Remilia's screen UP to shove every effect to its wildest
RANDOMIZE - builds a brand-new effect chain in one click
MUTATE - nudges the current chain for happy accidents
LOCK any slot so Randomize/Mutate leave it alone
10-slot FX chain - click to edit, drag to reorder, double-click to bypass
LAYER slots to run effects in parallel and stack them
Per-effect preset menu on every slot
Distortion, Overdrive, Slow Fuzz, Bitcrush (+Whine), Wavefold, Smash
High-Pass, Low-Pass, Para EQ, Mod EQ, Auto-Wah
Chorus, Phaser, Flanger, Widener, Wobble
Ring Mod, Freq Shifter, Octave Screech, Formant Yell, Metal Comb
Stutter, Glitch, Gate/Chop, Attack Shaper
Waveshaper - 16 curves (Soft/Hard Clip, Tube, Diode, Foldback, Sine Fold, Cheby 3/5, Rectify, Steps, Wrap, Ripple, Fuzz Spike, Bit Mangle, Crossover) with MORPH + BIAS
Busted Speaker - Phone, Laptop, Walkie-Talkie, AM Radio, Blown Woofer, Earbud, 2009 Upload, Toy, with RATTLE + STATIC
Boing - Spring, Pipe, String, Ruler resonators with cartoon WOBBLE
Fly-By - real Doppler pitch bend (Per Note, Loop, Random)
Intro FX - Swell, Reverse, Scoop Up, Dive Down, Stutter-In, Filter Rise, Wobble-In, Crush-In
SFX Layer - load any sound, stretched to each 808 note
Reverb + Delay built into the same chain
Built-in Youkai808 Synth - makes the 808 itself, then runs your chain
Synth wavetables: 808 Sine, Analog, Pulse, Harmonics, FM, Vowel, Sync, Fold, Crushed, Growl, Buzz + USER
808 sample sources: Plugg Sub, Pluggnb, Punchy, Stereo, Zay 1/Punchy/Stereo, Ambient, Jugg Sub
LOAD WT - import your own wavetable .wav (Serum tables work)
Osc shaping: POSITION, GLIDE, PUNCH, ATTACK, DECAY, RELEASE, TENSION, TUNE
ADVANCED tab: Tone, Input, Bass Guard freq, Mono Sub, Width, L/R Spread, Ceiling, Soft Attack, Limiter, Soft Clip, HQ 2x oversampling
Hover anything in the plugin for a plain-English explanation
VST3, CLAP & AU
tips: Want insanely crazy 808s? Stack 3-4 distortion slots in a row and crank DRIVE - each one eats the last lol
Blown-out TDF sub: push FAT most of the way, add Smash + Bitcrush, then pull BASS GUARD right to keep the low end knocking
Whiny Mackk-type 808? Use the synth, turn up GLIDE and PUNCH, then add Octave Screech or Formant Yell
Hit RANDOMIZE till something slaps, LOCK the slots you like, then keep rolling the rest
Right-click a slot and LAYER it to run two effects in parallel - way nastier than in a row
Drag Remilia's screen UP (CURSED) for instant chaos, then dial it back with MIX if it's too much
Keep it mono down low: ADVANCED > Mono Sub so it still hits on phone speakers and club systems
Automate CHAOS in your DAW on a build-up - everything gets wilder as it rises

products.name: Melody Veil
products.tagline: Makes any beat easy to rap on: carves a pocket so your vocal sits on top.
products.about: Drop it on your beat or your melody bus. Melody Veil only pulls down what is actually too loud - the 808 wash, the mud, melodies piling into your vocal's spot - and brings back drum punch a slammed master flattened. Tuned from real clear vs muddy SoundCloud beats.
features: VEIL - one knob for how much room to carve
LEVEL - auto-matches the melody to a full-beat level so it sits right under your vocal
LEARN - play your beat, it listens 5 s and sets VEIL / LEAD / FOCUS for you
AUTO FOCUS - FOCUS follows your lead melody by itself
VOCAL SPACE meter - see how much room is open for your voice (Crowded / OK / Open)
COMPARE - hear the untouched beat at the same loudness
LEAD + FOCUS - make the catchy lead melody jump out
PUNCH - brings back flattened drum hits
WIDTH - push melodies to the sides, leave the centre for you
VOCAL KEY - sidechain your vocal so the pocket only opens while you rap
SMEAR / MUD / BOX / POCKET amount sliders with live meters
Only cuts what's too loud: clean beats stay untouched
Evens out melodies that jump in level (that one loud piano)
Mono low end so the 808 stays centred
Auto gain + soft clip: never quieter, never clipping
12 vocal-first presets: everyday, lead/melody, fix-the-beat, vocal key, creative
tips: Slammed YouTube type beat? Start on Unsquash
Route every melody track to one bus and put Melody Veil there, leave drums + 808 out
Want the beat to duck only when you rap? Ghost preset + sidechain your vocal
products.trial: full plugin, audio dips every 45 s

products.name: Plugg Bando Tape
products.tagline: Makes your beat sound like a 2018 SoundCloud plugg tape, then tells you what to fix in the mix.
products.about: Plugg Bando Tape brings back the beautiful trash of 2017-2018 SoundCloud plugg. Its main mode is built on the sound of Kayy Luciano, the backbone of Remilia Bandxz's plugg music: dark, sub-heavy, with a long soft 808 that the whole beat ducks under. XANGANG mode brings the loud, crunchy 16k-MP3 sound with hiss, and RAW is dense, slammed and melody-forward. A Mix Coach listens to your beat and tells you what to fix.
features: Kayy Luciano, XanGang and RAW modes, tuned from 20 real 2017-2018 reference beats
VOCAL POCKET: carves space in the center at 1-4 kHz where the rapper sits, so the melody stays wide
Resonant LOWPASS knob: the dark, muffled-but-clear Kayy Luciano filter (Fruity Filter sound)
LOWPASS + RESONANCE: the ringing, dark Purity-style filter from Kayy Luciano beats (resonance rings ~8 kHz)
Mix Coach: tells you which part to fix (chords, lead, bell, 808, hats), what to EQ, and when to widen or add a lowpass, steering toward a Kayy Luciano or XanGang mix
EQ PRESETS: turns the Mix Coach tips into drag-in EQ presets per part (808, Chords, Lead, Bells, Hats) for FL Parametric EQ 2 and FabFilter Pro-Q 4
WOBBLE: warped-cassette wow and flutter
A/B button: hear the beat without the plugin at the same loudness, so you judge the sound not the volume
CLIP, DUCK and MUD meters
ADVANCED page: 808 attack and sustain, saturation, exciter, mud, lo-fi, highpass, lowpass, width, tape hiss
LEARN REF + MATCH EQ: learn any reference beat and push yours toward it
17 presets (incl. KAYY 10Cell Ring, KAYY Legendary Wide, KAYY Warped Cassette, XANGANG Ready To Rap, RAW Bando Tape), edges glow when you push it hard
tips: Start on KAYY for classic plugg, switch to XANGANG for darker mixes
Hit LEARN REF on a beat you love, then MATCH to steal its tone
Watch the MUD meter - if it's lit, pull the mud slider down
products.trial: full plugin, audio dips every 45 s

products.name: SUKIMA
products.tagline: Opens a gap in your beat for the vocal and makes the melody clearer.
products.about: SUKIMA means "the gap." Put it on the beat and it opens a pocket for your voice without touching the groove: it moves a centered melody out to the sides, dips the center only where you rap, pushes the melody back behind you, and un-washes reverb tails so the beat reads clear. Pairs with Melody Veil - Veil carves the EQ, SUKIMA opens the space.
features: SPLIT - moves a centered melody out to left/right (mono-safe) and dips the center only where your voice sits
DEPTH - pushes the melody behind you so your vocal sits in front
CLARITY - un-washes reverb tails so the beat stops sounding smeared
SHINE - adds sparkle on the sides only, keeps the center clean for your voice
MOVE - opens the gap only while you rap (vocal sidechain)
Mix Coach: live plain-English tips for what to fix
Level-matched A/B so you judge the sound, not the volume
MONO check - make sure the widening still holds up on phone speakers
15 vocal-focused presets
VST3, Windows
tips: Put it after Melody Veil: Veil carves the EQ, SUKIMA opens the space
Turn MOVE up and sidechain your vocal so the gap only opens when you rap
Hit MONO check before you bounce - if the melody disappears, pull SPLIT back
products.trial: full plugin, audio dips every 5 s

products.name: ONI MASTER
products.tagline: Auto master for rap songs: loud vocals, crispy or present, with 808 clip, glue and saturation.
products.about: Drop ONI MASTER on your master bus and it finishes the song like a rap mastering engineer would - loud, with the vocal sitting on top, the 808 clipped so it hits without clipping the mix, glue to hold it together and saturation for colour. Every move is subtle: it polishes the song instead of crushing it.
features: LOUD VOCALS - pushes the vocal up front so the whole song reads loud and clear
CRISPY / PRESENT - pick the top-end tone: airy and crispy, or warm and present
808 CLIP - clips the 808 so it knocks hard without clipping the master
GLUE - gentle bus compression that holds the drums, melody and vocal together
SATURATION - adds colour and warmth so it doesn't sound flat
Every move is subtle - it polishes, never crushes
VST3, Windows
tips: Put it last on your master bus, after everything else
Start crispy for bright plugg, switch to present for darker, warmer beats
If the 808 is too wild, lean on 808 CLIP before you touch anything else
